prompt: What was state of the schools regarding integration in the hometown of Miller Williams when he began his master's degree in Zoology?
answer: When Miller Williams began his master’s in zoology at the University of Arkansas—around 1952–53—schools in his hometown of Hoxie were still racially segregated. Hoxie did not integrate its public schools until July 1955, making it one of Arkansas’s earliest districts to do so.
